precedence: Blake's house rules override MSCD5, riders and the blog.
counterparty_note: Blake chose full MSCD conformance on the other side's drafts; treat every let-pass rule as flag, but label style-only changes as style in the redline.

overrides.replacement: Active voice only. Recast passives: name the actor (any Person if unknown); legal fictions as 'This agreement treats X as' or a linking verb ('is effective'); amendments as 'The parties hereby amend the section titled ...'. See house-style.md section 1.
Digits for every number, including 1-10 and ordinals that count (2nd anniversary). Never start a sentence with a digit; restructure. See house-style.md section 2.

Hierarchy I. (articles), A. (sections), 1. (subsections), (a) (enumerated clauses), (i) (subclauses); one tab per level; native Word numbering; no only child at any level. See house-style.md section 3.

Avoid internal cross-references; where one is needed refer by the provision's heading, not its number. Headings must be unique and match exactly; delete or limit any headings-for-convenience clause (15.18). See house-style.md section 4.
Two spaces after sentence-ending punctuation within a paragraph; one space after a colon. See house-style.md section 5.
Capitalize attachment references (Schedule A, Exhibit 2); the rest of 5.78 (no emphasis, no quotation marks around the enumeration) still applies. See house-style.md section 6.
U.S. date form: January 1, 2027. MSCD 10.11-10.14 still apply. See house-style.md section 7.
Singular they is acceptable and preferred for an individual of unspecified gender; the rest of 17.11-17.18 applies.
No article before a defined party name, including common-noun terms: Company shall pay Employee, not the Company shall pay the Employee (house-style.md section 11).
A party-name definition takes no article: ("Company"), not (the "Company"). For other common-noun defined terms, 6.63 still applies: (the "Shares").
Capitalize attachment references (Schedule A, Exhibit 1); the rest of MSCD's restraint with initial capitals applies.
House wording, in the active: The verb that this agreement uses to introduce a statement of fact does not affect the remedies available for inaccuracy of that statement of fact.
Blake's decision: is not required to is a fixed exception to the active-voice rule; use it as MSCD prescribes.

additions.statement: Never use shall with a negative subject (Neither party shall, No Shareholder shall); use Neither party may / No Shareholder may (3.324). With a positive subject use shall not.
If the contract refers to provisions by heading, delete or limit a headings-for-convenience clause, which would undercut those references.

lint.note: suppress: drop a rule hit whose matched text fits the pattern (it already meets the house rule). broad_only: report the rule once as a count, because its trigger is a word that appears in nearly every contract; the analysis passes still apply it to every sentence. broad_only also holds the rules whose triggers matched 5 or more times in the 26-contract test corpus (November 2026) without once marking a problem a reviewer cited.
